result.planSummary: Implemented Story 5’s prepare-mode lower-band readiness gate by adding selected semantic lower-band catch-up with visible stderr warnings, wiring smart compact through the async lower-band compression dependencies, and updating service/command tests to cover both successful catch-up and chunk/band-specific failure blocking.

changedFiles.reason: Added selected lower-band catch-up targeting during prepare-mode readiness, emitted chunk/band stderr warnings, and blocked compact on catch-up failures instead of repairing legacy placeholder output.
Forwarded async lower-band compression dependencies into prepareAsyncThread so smart compact can use the configured catch-up provider path.
Added coverage for selected semantic lower-band catch-up success/failure and updated maintenance expectations away from placeholder regeneration.
Added smart compact coverage for selected semantic lower-band catch-up success/failure and updated the prepare-mode repair scenario to use canonical semantic chunks.

findingsFixed: Prepare-mode now performs synchronous catch-up for selected semantic lower-band output and emits visible chunk/band warnings before compact continues.
Smart compact now passes async-thread lower-band compression dependencies into readiness preparation, so configured catch-up providers are actually used.
Catch-up failures now block smart compact before generated output write/reload and surface chunk/band-specific failure messages.
findingsSurfaced: Background async lower-band scheduling still emits noisy fixture-driven chunk-001 failure logs in some tests; it is non-blocking but worth cleanup in a follow-up.

openQuestions: Should the fixture-only async lower-band scheduling noise around synthetic chunk-001 work be cleaned up now, or left for a separate test-harness follow-up?
result.recommendedNextStep: Proceed to verification with emphasis on the selected-band catch-up path, then optionally clean up the noisy background lower-band test logging in a follow-up.
